propositions: The module-size gate shell step runs under bash -e -o pipefail and aborts with exit 1 when grep finds no non-comment lines in an empty allowlist, preventing the over-cap check from running.
The grep -vE line filtering the allowlist returns exit code 1 on no match, which propagates through pipefail and set -e and terminates the step prematurely.
Wrapping the grep command with || true allows the pipeline to continue when the allowlist is empty, preserving correct gate behavior for both empty and non-empty allowlists.
The same one-line fix must be applied identically to the listed= assignment in both gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml workflows.
The gate must still fail with exit 1 when an over-cap file is not listed in the allowlist, regardless of allowlist fullness.
